response.sql: WITH per_race AS (SELECT raceId, AVG(points) AS avg_points, AVG(wins) AS avg_wins FROM constructorStandings WHERE points > 6.0 GROUP BY raceId), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS overall_avg FROM per_race) SELECT p.raceId, p.avg_points, p.avg_wins, p.avg_wins - o.overall_avg AS diff FROM per_race p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (p.avg_wins - o.overall_avg) IS NULL, diff DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: 'Clear the 6.0-point threshold' means strictly greater than 6.0 (points > 6.0); entries with exactly 6.0 are excluded.
Races with no qualifying entries are absent from the per-race set, so they are not counted in the overall average and not listed.
The overall average is the unweighted mean of per-race average wins (each race counts equally).
